description.value: Normally, armor interferes with a spellcaster's gestures, causing spells with somatic components to fail. A red mage's limited focus and specialized training allow him to avoid spell failure so long as he sticks to light armor and light shields. This training does not extend to medium armor or heavy shields, and does not apply to spells gained from a different spellcasting class. At 7th level, a red mage learns to use medium armor with no chance of spell failure. At 10th level, he learns to use heavy shields with no chance of spell failure.
